data.gender_notes: Khairah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'khayr' meaning 'good' or 'beneficent'. In Islamic tradition, Khairah is a name given to a girl symbolizing goodness, kindness, and beauty. The name Khairah carries the meaning “Good, Kind, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khairah usually hope their child will grow to embody good, kind, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
